from AlgorithmImports import *
from datetime import timedelta, time


class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone("America/New_York")

        # Subscribe to SPY equity with raw data normalization
        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.spy.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy_symbol = self.spy.Symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY option universe
        self.option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = self.option.Symbol
        self.option.SetFilter(self.OptionFilter)

        # 5-minute consolidator and moving averages
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        self.consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, self.consolidator)

        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        # Position and Order State Tracking
        self.held_symbol = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.entry_order_id = None
        self.exit_order_id = None
        self.is_entry_pending = False
        self.no_entry_date = None

    def OptionFilter(self, universe):
        # Calls only, strikes 0 to +30 relative to underlying, expiration 7 to 60 days
        return universe.CallsOnly().Strikes(0, 30).Expiration(7, 60)

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar: TradeBar):
        # Update indicators only on actual consolidated 5-minute bars
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not (self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady):
            return

        curr_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        curr_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Check for bullish crossover when previous indicator values are available
        if self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            is_crossover = (self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow) and (curr_fast > curr_slow)
            if is_crossover:
                bar_time = bar.EndTime.time()
                # Eligible crossover bar end time: 09:45 through 14:30 inclusive
                if time(9, 45) <= bar_time <= time(14, 30):
                    self.EvaluateEntry()

        self.prev_fast = curr_fast
        self.prev_slow = curr_slow

    def EvaluateEntry(self):
        # Do not open if entry order is pending, replacement trade forbidden today, or holding exists
        if self.is_entry_pending:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry signal at {self.Time}: Entry order already open/pending.")
            return

        if self.no_entry_date == self.Time.date():
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry signal at {self.Time}: Replacement trade forbidden today after expiration processing.")
            return

        if any(holding.Invested for symbol, holding in self.Portfolio.items() if symbol.SecurityType == SecurityType.Option):
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry signal at {self.Time}: Option position already held.")
            return

        slice = self.CurrentSlice
        if slice is None or slice.OptionChains is None or slice.OptionChains.Count == 0:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry signal at {self.Time}: No option chain delivered in current slice.")
            return

        chain = slice.OptionChains.GetValue(self.option_symbol)
        if chain is None:
            chains = list(slice.OptionChains.Values)
            if len(chains) > 0:
                chain = chains[0]
            else:
                self.Debug(f"Skipped entry signal at {self.Time}: Option chain empty.")
                return

        curr_date = self.Time.date()
        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price
        if spy_price <= 0:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry signal at {self.Time}: Invalid SPY price ({spy_price}).")
            return

        # Find expirations at least 7 calendar days after current algorithm date
        expirations = {contract.Expiry.date() for contract in chain}
        valid_expirations = [exp for exp in expirations if (exp - curr_date).days >= 7]

        if not valid_expirations:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry signal at {self.Time}: No expiration date >= 7 calendar days out.")
            return

        target_exp = min(valid_expirations)
        target_strike_min = 1.01 * spy_price

        matching_contracts = [
            c for c in chain
            if c.Expiry.date() == target_exp
            and c.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and c.Strike >= target_strike_min
        ]

        if not matching_contracts:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry signal at {self.Time}: No call contract at target exp {target_exp} with strike >= {target_strike_min:.2f}.")
            return

        # Lowest strike >= 101% OTM; tie-break by ascending string representation of Symbol
        selected_contract = min(matching_contracts, key=lambda c: (c.Strike, str(c.Symbol)))

        ticket = self.Buy(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        if ticket is not None:
            self.entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId
            self.is_entry_pending = True
            self.held_symbol = selected_contract.Symbol
            self.Debug(f"Entry order submitted at {self.Time}: Buy 1 {selected_contract.Symbol} (Strike: {selected_contract.Strike}, Exp: {selected_contract.Expiry.date()})")

    def OnData(self, slice: Slice):
        if self.held_symbol is None:
            return

        if not self.Portfolio[self.held_symbol].Invested:
            return

        exp_date = self.held_symbol.ID.Date.date()

        # Fallback check if position remains when expiration processing begins
        if self.Time.date() >= exp_date:
            self.Debug(f"Expiration day reached for {self.held_symbol} at {self.Time}. Liquidating immediately.")
            self.LiquidateOptionPosition("Expiration Processing")
            self.no_entry_date = self.Time.date()
            return

        # Scheduled Time Stop check: 15:45 NY time on trading day immediately preceding contract's expiration date
        if self.Time.hour == 15 and self.Time.minute == 45:
            if self.IsTradingDayBefore(self.Time.date(), exp_date):
                self.Debug(f"Scheduled 15:45 time stop triggered for {self.held_symbol} (Exp: {exp_date}). Liquidating.")
                self.LiquidateOptionPosition("15:45 Time Stop")
                return

        # Profit Target Evaluation (requires recorded filled entry price)
        if self.entry_price is None or self.entry_price <= 0:
            return

        # Current option price defined as midpoint of strictly positive bid and ask in current Slice
        has_valid_quote = False
        midpoint = 0.0

        if slice.QuoteBars.ContainsKey(self.held_symbol):
            qb = slice.QuoteBars[self.held_symbol]
            if qb.Bid is not None and qb.Ask is not None:
                bid = qb.Bid.Close
                ask = qb.Ask.Close
                if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                    midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                    has_valid_quote = True

        if has_valid_quote:
            if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:
                self.Debug(f"50% Profit Target reached for {self.held_symbol}: Midpoint {midpoint:.2f} >= 1.5x Entry {self.entry_price:.2f}. Liquidating.")
                self.LiquidateOptionPosition("50% Profit Target")

    def LiquidateOptionPosition(self, reason: str):
        if self.held_symbol is None:
            return

        quantity = self.Portfolio[self.held_symbol].Quantity
        if quantity != 0:
            if self.exit_order_id is not None:
                self.Transactions.CancelOrder(self.exit_order_id)
                self.exit_order_id = None

            ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.held_symbol, -quantity)
            if ticket is not None:
                self.exit_order_id = ticket.OrderId
                self.Debug(f"Exit order ({reason}) submitted for {self.held_symbol} at {self.Time}")

    def IsTradingDayBefore(self, current_date, exp_date):
        if current_date >= exp_date:
            return False
        prev_date = exp_date - timedelta(days=1)
        while prev_date > current_date:
            if self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Exchange.Hours.IsDateOpen(prev_date):
                return False
            prev_date -= timedelta(days=1)
        return self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Exchange.Hours.IsDateOpen(current_date)

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent: OrderEvent):
        if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
            if self.entry_order_id is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_order_id:
                self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.is_entry_pending = False
                self.Debug(f"Entry order filled: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {self.entry_price:.2f}")
            elif self.exit_order_id is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.exit_order_id:
                self.Debug(f"Exit order filled: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {orderEvent.FillPrice:.2f}")
                self.held_symbol = None
                self.entry_price = None
                self.exit_order_id = None

            # Unexpected exercise or assignment handling
            order = self.Transactions.GetOrderById(orderEvent.OrderId)
            if order is not None and order.Type == OrderType.OptionExercise:
                self.Debug(f"Unexpected option exercise event detected: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {orderEvent.FillPrice}")
            elif "assignment" in str(orderEvent.Message).lower() or "exercise" in str(orderEvent.Message).lower():
                self.Debug(f"Unexpected assignment/exercise event: {orderEvent.Symbol} - {orderEvent.Message}")

        elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid, OrderStatus.Rejected]:
            if self.entry_order_id is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_order_id:
                self.Debug(f"Entry order canceled/rejected: {orderEvent.Status}")
                self.is_entry_pending = False
                self.entry_order_id = None
                self.held_symbol = None
            elif self.exit_order_id is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.exit_order_id:
                self.Debug(f"Exit order canceled/rejected: {orderEvent.Status}")
                self.exit_order_id = None

from AlgorithmImports import *
from datetime import timedelta, time


class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        # Backtest Period and Capital
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)

        # Time Zone
        self.SetTimeZone("America/New_York")

        # Subscribe to SPY Equity (Minute resolution, Raw price)
        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.spy.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy_symbol = self.spy.Symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY Options (Minute resolution)
        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol
        # Filter calls with DTE between 7 and 90 calendar days to maintain a sufficient universe
        option.SetFilter(lambda u: u.CallsOnly().Strikes(-5, 40).Expiration(7, 90))

        # Consolidate SPY into 5-minute bars aligned to clock boundaries
        self.Consolidate(self.spy_symbol, timedelta(minutes=5), self.OnFiveMinuteBar)

        # Moving Averages on 5-minute closing prices
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # Algorithm State Management
        self.entry_order_id = None
        self.entry_fill_price = None
        self.held_option_symbol = None
        self.last_expiration_liquidated_date = None

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, bar: TradeBar):
        """
        Consolidated 5-minute SPY bar handler.
        Evaluates bullish crossover and triggers option entry.
        """
        # Capture indicator states before updating with the current completed 5-min bar
        was_ready = self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady
        prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value if was_ready else None
        prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value if was_ready else None

        # Update SMAs with current 5-minute bar close
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        # Both averages must be ready before testing the signal
        if not (was_ready and self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady):
            return

        curr_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        curr_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Bullish crossover condition: fast <= slow on preceding bar, fast > slow on current bar
        is_bullish_crossover = (prev_fast <= prev_slow) and (curr_fast > curr_slow)
        if not is_bullish_crossover:
            return

        # Entry window: crossover bar ends from 09:45 through 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_time <= time(14, 30)):
            return

        # Do not open replacement position if liquidated due to expiration safety today
        if self.last_expiration_liquidated_date == self.Time.date():
            self.Debug(f"Entry skipped: Position was liquidated due to expiration safety earlier today ({self.Time.date()}).")
            return

        # Do not enter while an option holding exists or an entry order is open
        if self.HasOptionHoldingOrOpenOrder():
            return

        # Evaluate option selection and place order immediately
        self.TryEnterPosition(bar.Close)

    def HasOptionHoldingOrOpenOrder(self) -> bool:
        if self.entry_order_id is not None:
            return True
        if self.held_option_symbol is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_option_symbol].Invested:
            return True
        for holding in self.Portfolio.Values:
            if holding.Symbol.SecurityType == SecurityType.Option and holding.Invested:
                return True
        return False

    def TryEnterPosition(self, bar_close: float):
        slice_data = self.CurrentSlice
        if slice_data is None or slice_data.OptionChains is None:
            self.Debug("Entry skipped: No OptionChains in current Slice.")
            return

        chain = None
        if self.option_symbol in slice_data.OptionChains:
            chain = slice_data.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        else:
            for c in slice_data.OptionChains.Values:
                if c.Symbol.Canonical == self.option_symbol or c.Symbol.Underlying == self.spy_symbol:
                    chain = c
                    break

        if chain is None or len([c for c in chain]) == 0:
            self.Debug("Entry skipped: SPY Option chain empty.")
            return

        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Rule 1: Expiration calendar date >= current date + 7 days
        valid_expiries = []
        for contract in chain:
            dte = (contract.Expiry.date() - current_date).days
            if dte >= 7:
                valid_expiries.append(contract.Expiry.date())

        if not valid_expiries:
            self.Debug("Entry skipped: No contracts with expiration >= 7 calendar days.")
            return

        # Select nearest expiration meeting rule 1
        min_expiry = min(valid_expiries)

        # Rule 2: Calls only, Strike >= 101% of current SPY price
        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price
        if spy_price <= 0:
            spy_price = bar_close
        target_strike = 1.01 * spy_price

        candidate_contracts = [
            c for c in chain
            if c.Expiry.date() == min_expiry
            and c.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and c.Strike >= target_strike
        ]

        if not candidate_contracts:
            self.Debug(f"Entry skipped: No Call contract found at expiry {min_expiry} with strike >= {target_strike:.2f} (SPY price: {spy_price:.2f}).")
            return

        # Rule 3: Lowest strike >= 101% SPY price; tie-breaker by ascending Symbol string
        min_strike = min(c.Strike for c in candidate_contracts)
        strike_tied = [c for c in candidate_contracts if c.Strike == min_strike]
        strike_tied.sort(key=lambda c: str(c.Symbol))
        selected_contract = strike_tied[0]

        # Submit market order for exactly 1 contract
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        if ticket is not None and ticket.OrderId > 0:
            self.entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId
            self.Debug(f"Entry order submitted: {selected_contract.Symbol} | Strike: {selected_contract.Strike} | Expiry: {selected_contract.Expiry.date()} | SPY Price: {spy_price:.2f}")

                self.held_contract_symbol = None
                self.filled_entry_price = None

                            self.liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)
                            self.held_contract_symbol = None
                            self.filled_entry_price = None

    def is_trading_day_before_expiry(self, today, exp_date):
        if today >= exp_date:
            return False

        trading_days = self.trading_calendar.get_trading_days(today, exp_date)
        open_days = [d.date.date() for d in trading_days if d.is_open]

        if not open_days:
            return False

        if exp_date in open_days:
            return len(open_days) >= 2 and open_days[-2] == today
        else:
            return open_days[-1] == today

        # Time Window Check: Crossover bar end time must be from 09:45 through 14:30 NY time inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.end_time.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30)):

        if slice_data is None:
            self.debug(f"{self.time}: Entry skipped - Slice is None.")
            return

        # Inspect option chain delivered in current Slice
        chain = None
        if slice_data.option_chains.contains_key(self.option_symbol):

        else:
            for kvp in slice_data.option_chains:
                if kvp.key.canonical == self.option_symbol or kvp.key.underlying == self.spy.symbol:

            return

        valid_expiries = sorted(list(set(

            self.debug(f"{self.time}: Entry skipped - No expiration >= 7 calendar days out.")

        for order in self.transactions.get_open_orders():
            if order.security_type == SecurityType.OPTION:

                self.filled_entry_price = None
                return

        if slice_data.quote_bars.contains_key(self.held_contract_symbol):

from AlgorithmImports import *
from datetime import time, timedelta


class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    """
    QuantConnect LEAN Algorithm: SPY Long Call Strategy based on 5-Minute Moving Average Crossover.
    
    Strategy Rules:
    - SPY 5-minute TradeBar moving averages: Fast (5-bar SMA) vs Slow (20-bar SMA).
    - Entry signal: Bullish crossover (Fast <= Slow on prior 5-min bar, Fast > Slow on current 5-min bar).
    - Time window filter: Bar ends between 09:45 and 14:30 New York time, inclusive.
    - Contract selection: Nearest call option with DTE >= 7 calendar days, strike >= 101% of SPY price.
    - Tie-breaker: Ascending strike, then ascending symbol string.
    - Position size: Exactly 1 long call contract.
    - Exit rules:
        1. 50% profit target based on positive bid/ask midpoint (mid >= 1.50 * fill_price).
        2. Time stop at 15:45 NY time on the trading day immediately preceding expiration date.
        3. Safety liquidation on/after expiration date if still open (no replacements that day).
    """

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)

        self.SetTimeZone(TimeZones.NewYork)

        # Subscribe to SPY raw price equity without synthetic forward-filling
        equity = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute, Market.USA, fillDataForward=False, leverage=1.0)
        equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy_symbol = equity.Symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY options at minute resolution
        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol
        option.SetFilter(self.OptionFilter)

        # Consolidator for 5-minute SPY TradeBars aligned to market clock boundaries
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5))
        self.consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, self.consolidator)

        # Simple Moving Averages for 5-minute closing prices
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        # State tracking
        self.holding_option_symbol = None
        self.entry_fill_price = None
        self.is_entry_order_open = False
        self.pending_entry_symbol = None
        self.pending_entry_signal = False
        self.no_trade_date = None

    def OptionFilter(self, universe):
        """
        Broad universe filter to capture relevant Call contracts.
        """
        return universe.CallsOnly().Expiration(7, 60).Strikes(0, 30)

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar):
        """
        Evaluates indicator updates and crossover signals on completed 5-minute SPY bars.
        """
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        # Warmup check: both moving averages must be ready
        if not (self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady):
            self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
            self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value
            return

        current_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        current_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Bullish crossover check
        is_crossover = (
            self.prev_fast is not None
            and self.prev_slow is not None
            and self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow
            and current_fast > current_slow
        )

        # Bar end time filter: 09:45 through 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        time_valid = time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30)

        if is_crossover and time_valid:
            self.pending_entry_signal = True

        self.prev_fast = current_fast
        self.prev_slow = current_slow

    def OnData(self, slice):
        """
        Evaluates exits and processes single-shot entry evaluation on each minute slice.
        """
        # 1. Evaluate exits for existing position
        if self.holding_option_symbol is not None:
            holding = self.Portfolio[self.holding_option_symbol]
            if holding.Invested and holding.Quantity > 0:
                exp_date = self.holding_option_symbol.ID.Date.date()
                current_date = self.Time.date()

                # Safety liquidation on or after contract expiration date
                if current_date >= exp_date:
                    self.Debug(
                        f"Expiration Safety Triggered: Liquidating position {self.holding_option_symbol} on/after exp date {exp_date}."
                    )
                    self.no_trade_date = current_date
                    self.LiquidatePosition(self.holding_option_symbol, holding.Quantity, "Expiration Safety")
                    self.pending_entry_signal = False
                    return

                # Scheduled time stop: 15:45 NY time on trading day immediately preceding expiration date
                if self.Time.hour == 15 and self.Time.minute == 45:
                    if self.IsPriorTradingDay(current_date, exp_date):
                        self.LiquidatePosition(
                            self.holding_option_symbol, holding.Quantity, "15:45 Pre-Expiration Scheduled Exit"
                        )
                        return

                # Profit target test: midpoint of positive bid/ask >= 1.50 * fill price
                if self.entry_fill_price is not None and self.entry_fill_price > 0:
                    mid_price = self.GetOptionMidPrice(slice, self.holding_option_symbol)
                    if mid_price is not None:
                        if mid_price >= 1.50 * self.entry_fill_price:
                            self.LiquidatePosition(
                                self.holding_option_symbol,
                                holding.Quantity,
                                f"50% Profit Target Reached (Mid: {mid_price:.2f}, Fill: {self.entry_fill_price:.2f})",
                            )
                            return
            else:
                # Synchronize state if position is no longer invested
                if not holding.Invested and not self.is_entry_order_open:
                    self.holding_option_symbol = None
                    self.entry_fill_price = None

        # 2. Evaluate entry signal ONCE immediately after eligible 5-minute bar closes
        if self.pending_entry_signal:
            self.TryExecuteEntry(slice)

    def TryExecuteEntry(self, slice):
        """
        Inspects option chain and places market order for selected call contract.
        Signal is consumed immediately and never queued.
        """
        # Always consume signal immediately
        self.pending_entry_signal = False

        # Guard against multiple open holdings or pending entry orders
        if self.holding_option_symbol is not None or self.is_entry_order_open:
            return

        # Guard against same-day trading after expiration processing fallback
        if self.no_trade_date == self.Time.date():
            self.Debug("Skipped entry signal: Trading paused today due to expiration processing.")
            return

        # Inspect option chain
        if not slice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            self.Debug("Skipped entry signal: Option chain not available in current Slice.")
            return

        chain = slice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        contracts = [c for c in chain]
        if not contracts:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry signal: Option chain is empty in current Slice.")
            return

        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Expiration selection: Nearest expiration date with DTE >= 7 calendar days
        valid_expirations = set()
        for c in contracts:
            dte = (c.Expiration.date() - current_date).days
            if dte >= 7:
                valid_expirations.add(c.Expiration.date())

        if not valid_expirations:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry signal: No option expiration found with DTE >= 7 calendar days.")
            return

        target_exp = min(valid_expirations)

        # Obtain underlying price
        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price
        if spy_price <= 0:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry signal: SPY price is invalid or nonpositive.")
            return

        min_strike = 1.01 * spy_price

        # Strike selection: Call contract with lowest strike >= 101% of current SPY price
        candidates = [
            c
            for c in contracts
            if c.Expiration.date() == target_exp
            and c.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and c.Strike >= min_strike
        ]

        if not candidates:
            self.Debug(
                f"Skipped entry signal: No Call contract found at expiration {target_exp} with strike >= {min_strike:.2f} (SPY Price: {spy_price:.2f})."
            )
            return

        # Sort by strike ascending, tie-break by contract Symbol string ascending
        candidates.sort(key=lambda c: (c.Strike, str(c.Symbol)))
        selected = candidates[0]

        # Order placement
        self.is_entry_order_open = True
        self.pending_entry_symbol = selected.Symbol
        self.MarketOrder(selected.Symbol, 1)
        self.Debug(
            f"ENTRY ORDER SUBMITTED: 1 contract of {selected.Symbol} | Strike: {selected.Strike:.2f} | Exp: {selected.Expiration.date()} | SPY: {spy_price:.2f}"
        )

    def LiquidatePosition(self, symbol, quantity, reason):
        """

        """

    - SPY 5-minute TradeBar moving averages: Fast (5-bar SMA) vs Slow (20-bar SMA).
    - Entry signal: Bullish crossover (Fast <= Slow on prior 5-min bar, Fast > Slow on current 5-min bar).
    - Time window filter: Bar ends between 09:45 and 14:30 New York time, inclusive.
    - Contract selection: Nearest call option with DTE >= 7 calendar days, strike >= 101% of SPY price.
    - Tie-breaker: Ascending strike, then ascending symbol string.
    - Position size: Exactly 1 long call contract.
    - Exit rules:
        1. 50% profit target based on positive bid/ask midpoint (mid >= 1.50 * fill_price).
        2. Time stop at 15:45 NY time on the trading day immediately preceding expiration date.
        3. Safety liquidation on/after expiration date if still open (no replacements that day).
    """

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)

        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol
        option.SetFilter(self.OptionFilter)

        # Consolidator for 5-minute SPY TradeBars aligned to market clock boundaries
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5))
        self.consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, self.consolidator)

        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        self.holding_option_symbol = None

        return universe.CallsOnly().Expiration(7, 60).Strikes(0, 30)

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar):

        """
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

            self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value
            return

        current_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        is_crossover = (
            self.prev_fast is not None
            and self.prev_slow is not None
            and self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow
            and current_fast > current_slow
        )

        # Bar end time filter: 09:45 through 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        time_valid = time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30)

        self.prev_slow = current_slow

                    self.pending_entry_signal = False
                    return

                if self.Time.hour == 15 and self.Time.minute == 45:

from AlgorithmImports import *

class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    """
    QuantConnect LEAN Algorithm: SPY 5-Minute SMA Crossover Call Option Strategy
    
    Rules:
    - SPY Equity (Minute, Raw Data) & SPY Options (Minute).
    - 5-minute TradeBar Consolidator aligned to NY clock boundaries.
    - Fast SMA (5-bar) and Slow SMA (20-bar) on 5-minute SPY closes.
    - Bullish Crossover: Fast <= Slow (prev bar) and Fast > Slow (current bar).
    - Signal Window: 09:45 to 14:30 NY time, inclusive.
    - Option Filter: Calls only, nearest Expiration >= 7 calendar DTE, lowest Strike >= 101% SPY price.
    - Order: Market order for 1 contract. Entry price recorded strictly on order fill.
    - Exits: 
        1. 50% Profit Target based on strictly positive bid/ask midpoint.
        2. Time Stop: 15:45 NY time on the trading day immediately preceding expiration.
        3. Expiration Safeguard: Force-liquidate if held on/after expiration day.
    """

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone(TimeZones.NewYork)

        # Add SPY Equity
        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute, Market.USA)
        self.spy.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)

        # Add SPY Options
        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol
        option.SetFilter(self.OptionUniverseFilter)

        # 5-minute TradeBar Consolidator aligned to NY clock boundaries
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5))
        self.consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy.Symbol, self.consolidator)

        # 5-minute SMAs
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        # Position and Order Tracking
        self.held_contract = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.entry_order_id = None
        self.is_entry_order_open = False
        self.invalidated_day = None

        # Schedule daily check for the 15:45 Time Stop
        self.Schedule.On(
            self.DateRules.EveryDay("SPY"),
            self.TimeRules.At(15, 45),
            self.CheckTimeStop
        )

    def OptionUniverseFilter(self, universe):
        # Broad filter ensuring calls >= 7 DTE and >= 1% OTM are delivered
        return universe.CallsOnly().Expiration(7, 60).Strikes(0, 30)

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar):
        # Update SMAs strictly on actual 5-minute consolidated TradeBars
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

            return

        current_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        current_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Check for bullish crossover
        crossover = False
        if self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            if self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow and current_fast > current_slow:
                crossover = True

        self.prev_fast = current_fast
        self.prev_slow = current_slow

        if not crossover:
            return

        # Check time window: 09:45 to 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30)):
            return

        # Do not enter if already holding an option or if entry order is open
        if self.Portfolio.Invested or self.is_entry_order_open:
            return

        # Do not enter if trading was invalidated for today due to forced liquidation
        if self.invalidated_day == self.Time.date():
            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Signal skipped: Trading invalidated for {self.Time.date()}.")
            return

        # Signal triggered: Select contract and enter
        self.TryEnterPosition(bar.Close)

    def TryEnterPosition(self, spy_price):
        if self.CurrentSlice is None or not self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Signal skipped: Option chain missing from slice.")
            return

        chain = self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        current_date = self.Time.date()
        min_target_strike = 1.01 * spy_price

        # Filter candidate contracts:
        # 1. Option type: Call
        # 2. Calendar DTE >= 7 days
        # 3. Strike >= 101% of current SPY price
        candidates = []
        for contract in chain:
            if contract.Right != OptionRight.Call:
                continue
            dte = (contract.Expiry.date() - current_date).days
            if dte < 7:
                continue
            if contract.Strike < min_target_strike:
                continue
            candidates.append(contract)

        if not candidates:
            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Signal skipped: No Call contract found matching DTE >= 7 and Strike >= {min_target_strike:.2f}.")
            return

        # Select nearest expiration meeting DTE rule
        min_expiry = min(c.Expiry.date() for c in candidates)
        expiry_candidates = [c for c in candidates if c.Expiry.date() == min_expiry]

        # Select lowest strike >= 101% SPY price; break tie by ascending string symbol
        expiry_candidates.sort(key=lambda c: (c.Strike, str(c.Symbol)))
        selected_contract = expiry_candidates[0]

        # Submit Market Order for exactly 1 contract
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)

                self.Liquidate(self.held_contract)

                ask = qb.Ask.Close
                if bid > 0 and ask > 0:

                    if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:

    QuantConnect LEAN Algorithm: SPY 5-Minute SMA Crossover Call Option Strategy
    
    Rules:
    - SPY Equity (Minute, Raw Data) & SPY Options (Minute).
    - 5-minute TradeBar Consolidator aligned to NY clock boundaries.
    - Fast SMA (5-bar) and Slow SMA (20-bar) on 5-minute SPY closes.
    - Bullish Crossover: Fast <= Slow (prev bar) and Fast > Slow (current bar).
    - Signal Window: 09:45 to 14:30 NY time, inclusive.
    - Option Filter: Calls only, nearest Expiration >= 7 calendar DTE, lowest Strike >= 101% SPY price.
    - Order: Market order for 1 contract. Entry price recorded strictly on order fill.
    - Exits: 
        1. 50% Profit Target based on strictly positive bid/ask midpoint.
        2. Time Stop: 15:45 NY time on the trading day immediately preceding expiration.
        3. Expiration Safeguard: Force-liquidate if held on/after expiration day.
    """

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone(TimeZones.NewYork)

        # Add SPY Equity
        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute, Market.USA)
        self.spy.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)

        # Add SPY Options
        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol
        option.SetFilter(self.OptionUniverseFilter)

        # 5-minute TradeBar Consolidator aligned to NY clock boundaries
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5))
        self.consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy.Symbol, self.consolidator)

        # 5-minute SMAs
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        # Position and Order Tracking
        self.held_contract = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.entry_order_id = None
        self.is_entry_order_open = False
        self.invalidated_day = None

        # Schedule daily check for the 15:45 Time Stop
        self.Schedule.On(
            self.DateRules.EveryDay("SPY"),
            self.TimeRules.At(15, 45),
            self.CheckTimeStop
        )

    def OptionUniverseFilter(self, universe):
        # Broad filter ensuring calls >= 7 DTE and >= 1% OTM are delivered
        return universe.CallsOnly().Expiration(7, 60).Strikes(0, 30)

        # Update SMAs strictly on actual 5-minute consolidated TradeBars
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not self.fast_sma.IsReady or not self.slow_sma.IsReady:
            return

        current_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        current_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Check for bullish crossover
        crossover = False
        if self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            if self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow and current_fast > current_slow:
                crossover = True

        self.prev_fast = current_fast
        self.prev_slow = current_slow

        # Check time window: 09:45 to 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30)):

        if self.Portfolio.Invested or self.is_entry_order_open:
            return

        if self.invalidated_day == self.Time.date():
            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Signal skipped: Trading invalidated for {self.Time.date()}.")
            return

        # Signal triggered: Select contract and enter
        self.TryEnterPosition(bar.Close)

            dte = (contract.Expiry.date() - current_date).days

            if contract.Strike < min_target_strike:

                        )
                        self.Liquidate(self.held_contract)

    def GetMidPrice(self, slice, symbol):
        # Calculate midpoint of strictly positive bid and ask
        if slice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            chain = slice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
            contract_data = chain.GetContract(symbol)
            if contract_data is not None:
                bid = contract_data.BidPrice
                ask = contract_data.AskPrice
                if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                    return (bid + ask) / 2.0

        if self.Securities.ContainsKey(symbol):
            sec = self.Securities[symbol]
            bid = sec.BidPrice
            ask = sec.AskPrice
            if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                return (bid + ask) / 2.0

        return None

    def IsPrecedingTradingDay(self, current_date, expiry_date):
        if current_date >= expiry_date:
            return False

        # Verify no intermediate market open days exist between current_date and expiry_date
        check_date = current_date + timedelta(days=1)
        while check_date < expiry_date:
            trading_day = self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDay(check_date)
            if trading_day is not None and trading_day.IsMarketOpen:
                return False
            check_date += timedelta(days=1)
        return True

        valid_contracts = []

        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol

        # 5-Minute TradeBar Consolidator aligned to New York clock boundaries
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        self.consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, self.consolidator)

        # Indicators for 5-minute closing prices
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # Execution and state management
        self.entry_price = None
        self.held_contract = None
        self.entry_pending = False

        # Warm up moving averages with 5-minute historical SPY TradeBars
        self.WarmUpIndicators()

    def OptionFilter(self, universe):
        # Filter option chain for calls, DTE between 7 and 60 calendar days, strikes above ATM
        return universe.CallsOnly().Strikes(-2, 40).Expiration(7, 60)

    def WarmUpIndicators(self):
        # Retrieve historical 5-minute TradeBars for warmup
        history = self.History(TradeBar, self.spy_symbol, 200, Resolution.FiveMinutes)
        for bar in history:
            self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
            self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar):
        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        # Record values prior to update if both averages were ready
        was_ready = self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady
        prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value if was_ready else None
        prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value if was_ready else None

        # Update indicators with the completed 5-minute bar
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        is_ready = self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady

        # Both averages must be ready before testing the signal
        if not (was_ready and is_ready):
            return

        curr_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        curr_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Bullish Crossover: fast <= slow on preceding bar AND fast > slow on current bar
        if prev_fast <= prev_slow and curr_fast > curr_slow:
            # Check entry window: crossover bar end time from 09:45 through 14:30 NY time inclusive
            bar_time = bar.EndTime.time()
            start_time = datetime.strptime("09:45", "%H:%M").time()
            end_time = datetime.strptime("14:30", "%H:%M").time()

            if start_time <= bar_time <= end_time:
                # Only enter if not already holding an option and no entry order is open
                if self.held_contract is None and not self.entry_pending:
                    self.TryEntry()

    def TryEntry(self):
        slice = self.CurrentSlice
        if slice is None or not slice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Entry Skipped: No option chain available in current Slice.")
            return

        chain = slice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price

        if spy_price <= 0:
            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Entry Skipped: Invalid SPY price.")
            return

        target_strike = spy_price * 1.01
        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Filter chain for calls with DTE >= 7 calendar days and strike >= 101% of SPY price
        valid_contracts = []
        for contract in chain:
            if contract.Right != OptionRight.Call:
                continue
            dte = (contract.Expiry.date() - current_date).days
            if dte >= 7 and contract.Strike >= target_strike:
                valid_contracts.append(contract)

        if not valid_contracts:
            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Entry Skipped: No valid call contracts found (DTE >= 7, Strike >= 101% SPY).")
            return

        # Select nearest expiration date at least 7 calendar days out
        min_exp_date = min(c.Expiry.date() for c in valid_contracts)
        exp_contracts = [c for c in valid_contracts if c.Expiry.date() == min_exp_date]

        # Select lowest strike at or above 101% SPY price
        min_strike = min(c.Strike for c in exp_contracts)
        strike_contracts = [c for c in exp_contracts if c.Strike == min_strike]

        # Break tie by ascending string value of contract Symbol
        selected_contract = sorted(strike_contracts, key=lambda c: c.Symbol.Value)[0]

        # Submit market order for 1 contract
        self.entry_pending = True
        self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Entry Order Submitted: {selected_contract.Symbol.Value} | Strike: {selected_contract.Strike} | Expiry: {selected_contract.Expiry.date()}")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):
        if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
            order = self.Transactions.GetOrderById(orderEvent.OrderId)

            # Entry Fill
            if self.entry_pending and order.Symbol.SecurityType == SecurityType.Option and orderEvent.Quantity > 0:
                self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.held_contract = order.Symbol
                self.entry_pending = False
                self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Entry Filled: {order.Symbol.Value} @ ${self.entry_price:.2f}")

            # Exit Fill
            elif self.held_contract is not None and order.Symbol == self.held_contract and orderEvent.Quantity < 0:
                self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Exit Filled: {order.Symbol.Value} @ ${orderEvent.FillPrice:.2f}")
                self.held_contract = None
                self.entry_price = None
                self.entry_pending = False

    def OnData(self, slice):
        if self.held_contract is None:
            return

        current_time = self.Time.time()
        current_date = self.Time.date()
        exp_date = self.held_contract.ID.Date.date()

        # Expiration Safety Check: Liquidate if accidentally held into expiration date
        if current_date >= exp_date:
            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Expiration Safety Triggered: Liquidating {self.held_contract.Value}")
            self.Liquidate(self.held_contract)
            return

        # Time Stop Check: 15:45 NY time on trading day immediately preceding expiration date
        if current_time >= datetime.strptime("15:45", "%H:%M").time():
            if self.IsPrecedingTradingDay(exp_date):
                self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Time Stop Triggered (15:45 day before expiration): Liquidating {self.held_contract.Value}")
                self.Liquidate(self.held_contract)
                return

        # Profit Target Check (50% profit target based on bid/ask midpoint)
        if slice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            chain = slice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
            for contract in chain:
                if contract.Symbol == self.held_contract:
                    bid = contract.BidPrice
                    ask = contract.AskPrice

                    # Evaluate only if bid and ask are strictly positive
                    if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                        midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                        if self.entry_price is not None and midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:
                            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Profit Target Reached (Mid: ${midpoint:.2f} >= 1.5x Entry: ${self.entry_price:.2f}): Liquidating {self.held_contract.Value}")
                            self.Liquidate(self.held_contract)

    def IsPrecedingTradingDay(self, exp_date):
        current_date = self.Time.date()
        if current_date >= exp_date:
            return False

        # Get trading days up to expiration date

        self.Debug(f"Unexpected assignment event for {assignmentEvent.Symbol}. Liquidating position.")

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time


class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    """
    QuantConnect LEAN Algorithm trading SPY Call Options based on 
    a 5-minute SPY moving average crossover signal.
    """

    def Initialize(self) -> None:
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone(TimeZones.NewYork)

        # Subscribe to SPY Equity minute data, raw prices, no forward fill
        spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute, Market.USA, fillDataForward=False, leverage=1.0)
        self.spy_symbol = spy.Symbol
        spy.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)

        # Subscribe to SPY Option minute data
        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol
        option.SetFilter(self.OptionFilter)

        # Consolidate SPY minute data into 5-minute TradeBars
        consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5))
        consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, consolidator)

        # Moving Averages on 5-minute closing prices
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None
        self.curr_fast = None
        self.curr_slow = None

        # Execution tracking state
        self.signal_pending = False
        self.held_contract = None
        self.entry_fill_price = None
        self.entry_ticket = None

    def OptionFilter(self, universe: OptionFilterUniverse) -> OptionFilterUniverse:
        """
        Option universe filter configured to return Call options with
        expiration between 7 and 90 days, with strike range covering 1% OTM options.
        """
        return universe.CallsOnly().Strikes(-5, 30).Expiration(TimeSpan.FromDays(7), TimeSpan.FromDays(90))

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender: object, bar: TradeBar) -> None:
        """
        Handler for completed 5-minute SPY TradeBars.
        Updates indicators and tests for bullish crossover signals within valid hours.
        """
        # Save previous indicator values if slow SMA was already ready
        if self.slow_sma.IsReady:
            self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
            self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value
        else:
            self.prev_fast = None
            self.prev_slow = None

        # Update moving averages with current 5-min close
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not self.slow_sma.IsReady or self.prev_fast is None or self.prev_slow is None:
            return

        self.curr_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        self.curr_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Bullish crossover: prev_fast <= prev_slow and curr_fast > curr_slow
        is_crossover = (self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow) and (self.curr_fast > self.curr_slow)

        # Check bar end time window: 09:45 through 14:30 New York time inclusive
        bar_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        time_valid = (bar_time >= time(9, 45)) and (bar_time <= time(14, 30))

        if is_crossover and time_valid:
            self.signal_pending = True

    def OnData(self, slice: Slice) -> None:
        """
        Evaluates signals on bar close and manages active option positions.
        """
        # Evaluate entry signal if triggered on the current bar close
        if self.signal_pending:
            self.TryExecuteEntry(slice)

        # Manage open option positions
        if self.held_contract is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested:
            current_date = self.Time.date()
            expiry_date = self.held_contract.ID.Date.date()

            # Expiration Safety: Never hold into expiration day
            if current_date >= expiry_date:
                self.Debug(f"Expiration safety triggered for {self.held_contract}. Liquidating immediately.")
                self.LiquidatePosition("Expiration Safety")
                return

            # Time Stop: 15:45 NY time on the trading day immediately preceding expiration date
            if self.Time.time() >= time(15, 45) and self.IsDayBeforeExpiration(current_date, expiry_date):
                self.Debug(f"Time stop reached at 15:45 on day before expiration for {self.held_contract}. Liquidating.")
                self.LiquidatePosition("Time Stop")
                return

            # Profit Target Test: 50% profit based on midpoint of bid/ask
            if self.entry_fill_price is not None and self.entry_fill_price > 0:
                bid = 0.0
                ask = 0.0

                if slice.QuoteBars.ContainsKey(self.held_contract):
                    qb = slice.QuoteBars[self.held_contract]
                    if qb.Bid is not None and qb.Ask is not None:
                        bid = qb.Bid.Close
                        ask = qb.Ask.Close
                elif self.Securities.ContainsKey(self.held_contract):
                    sec = self.Securities[self.held_contract]
                    bid = sec.BidPrice
                    ask = sec.AskPrice

                if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                    midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                    if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_fill_price:
                        self.Debug(f"Profit target reached for {self.held_contract}: Midpoint {midpoint:.2f} >= 1.50 * Entry {self.entry_fill_price:.2f}. Liquidating.")
                        self.LiquidatePosition("Profit Target")
                        return

    def TryExecuteEntry(self, slice: Slice) -> None:
        """
        Inspects option chain and places a market entry order for a single call contract if rules match.
        """
        # Clear signal flag regardless of outcome so signal is evaluated only once
        self.signal_pending = False

        # Do not enter if position already held or entry order pending fill
        if self.held_contract is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested:
            return

        if self.entry_ticket is not None and self.entry_ticket.Status in [OrderStatus.Submitted, OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled]:
            return

        # Retrieve option chain
        chain = slice.OptionChains.GetValue(self.option_symbol)
        if chain is None or len(list(chain)) == 0:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry signal: Option chain unavailable in current slice.")
            return

        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price
        if spy_price <= 0:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry signal: Invalid SPY price.")
            return

        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Filter valid calls with DTE >= 7 calendar days
        valid_contracts = []
        for contract in chain:
            if contract.Right != OptionRight.Call:
                continue
            dte = (contract.Expiry.date() - current_date).days
            if dte >= 7:
                valid_contracts.append(contract)

        if not valid_contracts:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry signal: No Call contract found with DTE >= 7 calendar days.")
            return

        # Nearest expiration date
        min_expiry = min(c.Expiry.date() for c in valid_contracts)
        expiry_contracts = [c for c in valid_contracts if c.Expiry.date() == min_expiry]

        # Select lowest strike >= 101% of current SPY price
        target_strike = 1.01 * spy_price
        strike_contracts = [c for c in expiry_contracts if c.Strike >= target_strike]

        if not strike_contracts:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry signal: No Call contract found with strike >= 101% of SPY price ({target_strike:.2f}).")
            return

        # Sort by strike ascending, tie-breaker ascending Symbol string
        selected_contract = sorted(strike_contracts, key=lambda c: (c.Strike, str(c.Symbol)))[0]

        # Order exactly 1 contract via Market Order
        self.held_contract = selected_contract.Symbol
        self.entry_ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        self.Debug(f"Submitted Entry Market Order for {selected_contract.Symbol} | SPY: {spy_price:.2f} | Strike: {selected_contract.Strike:.2f} | Expiry: {selected_contract.Expiry.date()}")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent: OrderEvent) -> None:
        """
        Processes order events to record exact fill price for entry or reset state on order failure.
        """
        if self.entry_ticket is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_ticket.OrderId:
            if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.entry_fill_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.Debug(f"Entry Fill Confirmed: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {self.entry_fill_price:.2f}")
            elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Rejected]:
                self.Debug(f"Entry Order {orderEvent.Status}: Resetting position state.")
                self.held_contract = None
                self.entry_fill_price = None
                self.entry_ticket = None

    def IsDayBeforeExpiration(self, current_date: datetime.date, expiry_date: datetime.date) -> bool:
        """
        Checks if current_date is the trading day immediately preceding expiry_date.
        """
        if current_date >= expiry_date:
            return False

        # Fetch trading days strictly between current_date and expiry_date
        start_check = current_date + timedelta(days=1)
        end_check = expiry_date - timedelta(days=1)
        
        if start_check > end_check:
            return True

        trading_days = self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDays(start_check, end_check)
        active_days = [d for d in trading_days if d.IsTradingDay]
        return len(active_days) == 0

    def LiquidatePosition(self, reason: str) -> None:
        """
        Submits market order to liquidate the active option holding.
        """
        if self.held_contract is not None:
            symbol = self.held_contract
            qty = self.Portfolio[symbol].Quantity
            if qty != 0:
                self.MarketOrder(symbol, -qty)
                self.Debug(f"Liquidating position ({reason}): {symbol} Qty: {-qty}")
            self.held_contract = None
            self.entry_fill_price = None
            self.entry_ticket = None

    def OnAssignment(self, assignmentEvent: AssignmentEvent) -> None:
        """
        Handles unexpected option assignment by logging and liquidating assigned equity positions.
        """
        self.Debug(f"Unexpected Assignment Event received: {assignmentEvent}")
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Invested:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy_symbol)
        self.held_contract = None
        self.entry_fill_price = None

        self.entry_fill_price = None

    def OptionFilter(self, universe: OptionFilterUniverse) -> OptionFilterUniverse:
        """

        expiration between 7 and 90 days, with strike range covering 1% OTM options.
        """

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender: object, bar: TradeBar) -> None:
        """
        Handler for completed 5-minute SPY TradeBars.
        Updates indicators and tests for bullish crossover signals within valid hours.
        """
        # Save previous indicator values if slow SMA was already ready
        if self.slow_sma.IsReady:
            self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
            self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value
        else:
            self.prev_fast = None
            self.prev_slow = None

        # Update moving averages with current 5-min close
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not self.slow_sma.IsReady or self.prev_fast is None or self.prev_slow is None:

        self.curr_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        self.curr_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        is_crossover = (self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow) and (self.curr_fast > self.curr_slow)

        bar_time = bar.EndTime.time()

        if chain is None or len(list(chain)) == 0:

            return

        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price
        if spy_price <= 0:

        expiry_contracts = [c for c in valid_contracts if c.Expiry.date() == min_expiry]

        target_strike = 1.01 * spy_price
        strike_contracts = [c for c in expiry_contracts if c.Strike >= target_strike]

        self.held_contract = selected_contract.Symbol
        self.entry_ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)

        """

        """

            if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.entry_fill_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.Debug(f"Entry Fill Confirmed: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {self.entry_fill_price:.2f}")
            elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Rejected]:

                self.held_contract = None
                self.entry_fill_price = None
                self.entry_ticket = None

    def IsDayBeforeExpiration(self, current_date: datetime.date, expiry_date: datetime.date) -> bool:
        """

        """

        # Fetch trading days strictly between current_date and expiry_date

        self.entry_fill_price = None
        self.entry_ticket = None

            and c.Strike >= min_strike

                    self.LiquidatePosition(self.held_contract)

        if self.option_symbol in slice.OptionChains:

        return None

    def GetContractBidAsk(self, slice: Slice, symbol: Symbol):
        bid, ask = None, None
        if slice.QuoteBars is not None and slice.QuoteBars.ContainsKey(symbol):

            if chain is not None:

                        ask = c.AskPrice

        return bid, ask

            check_date += datetime.timedelta(days=1)
        return True

        if symbol is None:
            return
        self.is_exit_pending = True
        self.Transactions.CancelOpenOrders(symbol)
        if self.Portfolio[symbol].Invested:
            qty = self.Portfolio[symbol].Quantity

            if order.Type in [OrderType.OptionExercise, OrderType.OptionAssignment]:

                self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.held_contract = orderEvent.Symbol
                self.is_entry_pending = False
                self.Debug(f"ENTRY FILLED: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {self.entry_price:.2f} (Order ID: {orderEvent.OrderId})")

            # Exit Order Fill

                if not self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested:
                    self.Debug(f"EXIT FILLED: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {orderEvent.FillPrice:.2f}")
                    self.held_contract = None
                    self.entry_price = None
                    self.entry_order_ticket = None
                    self.is_entry_pending = False
                    self.is_exit_pending = False

        elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid, OrderStatus.Rejected]:
            if self.entry_order_ticket is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_order_ticket.OrderId:
                self.Debug(f"ENTRY ORDER FAILED ({orderEvent.Status}): {orderEvent.Message}")
                self.is_entry_pending = False
                self.entry_order_ticket = None
            elif self.held_contract is not None and orderEvent.Symbol == self.held_contract:
                self.is_exit_pending = False

    def OnAssignment(self, assignmentEvent: AssignmentEvent):
        self.Debug(f"ASSIGNMENT NOTIFICATION: {assignmentEvent.Symbol}, Quantity: {assignmentEvent.Quantity}")

                bid = contract_data.BidPrice
                ask = contract_data.AskPrice
                if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                    return (bid + ask) / 2.0

        # Check Securities cache as fallback
        if self.Securities.ContainsKey(symbol):
            sec = self.Securities[symbol]
            bid = sec.BidPrice
            ask = sec.AskPrice
            if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                return (bid + ask) / 2.0

        return None

    def IsDayBeforeExpiration(self, expiry_date: datetime.date) -> bool:
        # Returns True if current date is the trading day immediately preceding contract expiration date
        if self.Time.date() >= expiry_date:

            check_date += timedelta(days=1)

        self.Debug(f"Unexpected Assignment Event received for {assignmentEvent.Symbol}: {assignmentEvent}")

        """
        fast_ready_before = self.fast.is_ready
        slow_ready_before = self.slow.is_ready

        p_fast = self.fast.current.value if fast_ready_before else None
        p_slow = self.slow.current.value if slow_ready_before else None

        # Update SMAs with 5-minute close
        self.fast.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)
        self.slow.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)

        c_fast = self.fast.current.value
        c_slow = self.slow.current.value

        bar_end_time = bar.end_time.time()
        in_time_window = (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30))

        self.check_exits(slice)

        if self.pending_signal:

            self.try_enter_position(slice)

            return

        if self.is_entry_pending:

            return

        target_min_strike = 1.01 * spy_price

        candidate_contracts = [
            c for c in chain
            if c.expiry.date() == selected_expiration
            and c.right == OptionRight.CALL
            and c.strike >= target_min_strike
        ]

            self.debug(f"[{self.time}] Entry Skipped: No call contracts at or above 101% SPY price ({target_min_strike:.2f}).")

        selected_contract = min(candidate_contracts, key=lambda c: (c.strike, str(c.symbol)))

        self.is_entry_pending = True
        self.entry_order_ticket = self.market_order(selected_contract.symbol, 1)
        self.debug(

            f"Strike: {selected_contract.strike} | Expiration: {selected_contract.expiry.date()} | SPY: {spy_price:.2f}"

        if self.held_contract_symbol is None:
            return

        expiry_date = self.held_contract_symbol.id.date.date()
        current_date = self.time.date()

        # Expiration Protection: Never hold into expiration day
        if current_date >= expiry_date:
            self.debug(f"[{self.time}] EMERGENCY EXIT: Contract {self.held_contract_symbol} reached expiration day ({current_date}). Liquidating.")
            self.transactions.cancel_open_orders(self.held_contract_symbol)
            self.liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)
            self.no_new_entries_today = True
            return

        if self.time.hour == 15 and self.time.minute == 45:
            if self.is_trading_day_before_expiration(current_date, expiry_date):
                self.debug(f"[{self.time}] TIME STOP EXIT: 15:45 on trading day before expiration for {self.held_contract_symbol}. Liquidating.")
                self.transactions.cancel_open_orders(self.held_contract_symbol)
                self.liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)
                return

        # Profit Target Check (50% gain)
        if self.entry_fill_price is not None and self.entry_fill_price > 0:
            if slice.quote_bars.contains_key(self.held_contract_symbol):
                quote = slice.quote_bars[self.held_contract_symbol]
                if quote.bid is not None and quote.ask is not None:
                    bid = quote.bid.close
                    ask = quote.ask.close
                    if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                        midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                        if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_fill_price:
                            self.debug(
                                f"[{self.time}] PROFIT TARGET HIT: Midpoint {midpoint:.2f} >= 1.5x Fill Price {self.entry_fill_price:.2f}. Liquidating {self.held_contract_symbol}."
                            )
                            self.transactions.cancel_open_orders(self.held_contract_symbol)
                            self.liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)

    def is_trading_day_before_expiration(self, today: datetime.date, expiry_date: datetime.date) -> bool:
        """
        Returns True if `today` is the last open trading day before `expiry_date`.
        """
        if today >= expiry_date:
            return False

        # Check for open trading days between today (exclusive) and expiry_date (exclusive)
        trading_days = self.trading_calendar.get_trading_days(
            today + timedelta(days=1),
            expiry_date - timedelta(days=1)
        )
        open_days_between = [d for d in trading_days if d.is_open]
        return len(open_days_between) == 0

    def on_order_event(self, order_event: OrderEvent) -> None:
        if order_event.status == OrderStatus.FILLED:
            # Handle Entry Fill
            if self.entry_order_ticket is not None and order_event.order_id == self.entry_order_ticket.order_id:
                self.entry_fill_price = order_event.fill_price
                self.held_contract_symbol = order_event.symbol
                self.is_entry_pending = False
                self.debug(f"[{self.time}] ENTRY FILLED: {order_event.symbol} at {self.entry_fill_price:.2f}")

            # Handle Exit Fill
            elif self.held_contract_symbol is not None and order_event.symbol == self.held_contract_symbol:
                if not self.portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].invested:
                    self.debug(f"[{self.time}] EXIT FILLED: {order_event.symbol} at {order_event.fill_price:.2f}")
                    self.held_contract_symbol = None
                    self.entry_fill_price = None
                    self.entry_order_ticket = None
                    self.is_entry_pending = False

        elif order_event.status in [OrderStatus.CANCELED, OrderStatus.INVALID, OrderStatus.REJECTED]:
            if self.entry_order_ticket is not None and order_event.order_id == self.entry_order_ticket.order_id:
                self.debug(f"[{self.time}] ENTRY ORDER {order_event.status}: {order_event.message}")
                self.is_entry_pending = False
                self.entry_order_ticket = None

        # Unexpected Assignment or Exercise logging
        if order_event.status == OrderStatus.OPTION_ASSIGNMENT:
            self.debug(f"[{self.time}] UNEXPECTED OPTION ASSIGNMENT: {order_event}")
            self.no_new_entries_today = True

                self.is_entry_order_open = False
                self.entry_order_ticket = None

    def is_preceding_trading_day(self, current_date, expiry_date):
        """Returns True if current_date is the trading day immediately preceding expiry_date."""
        if current_date >= expiry_date:

        """

        """
        bid, ask = None, None

        if slice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):

            contract = chain.Get(self.held_contract)

        if (bid is None or bid <= 0 or ask is None or ask <= 0) and slice.QuoteBars.ContainsKey(self.held_contract):
            qb = slice.QuoteBars[self.held_contract]
            if qb.Bid is not None and qb.Ask is not None:
                bid = qb.Bid.Close
                ask = qb.Ask.Close

        # Fallback to Securities cache if updated in current minute slice
        if (bid is None or bid <= 0 or ask is None or ask <= 0):
            sec = self.Securities.get(self.held_contract)
            if sec is not None and sec.GetLastData() is not None and sec.GetLastData().Time == self.Time:
                bid = sec.BidPrice
                ask = sec.AskPrice

        # Skip profit-target test if bid or ask missing/nonpositive
        if bid is not None and ask is not None and bid > 0 and ask > 0:
            midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0

                self.entry_fill_price = None

        """
        Returns True if current_date is the trading day immediately preceding contract exp_date.
        """
        if current_date >= exp_date:
            return False

        # Get trading days between current_date and exp_date inclusive
        trading_days = [
            day.Date.date() for day in self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDays(current_date, exp_date)
            if day.IsTradingDay
        ]

            idx = trading_days.index(current_date)
            if idx + 1 < len(trading_days):
                return trading_days[idx + 1] >= exp_date
            else:
                return True

        return False

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):

                self.held_contract = orderEvent.Symbol
                self.entry_fill_price = orderEvent.FillPrice

                self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Entry Filled: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {self.entry_fill_price:.2f}")

                if not self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested:
                    self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Exit Filled: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {orderEvent.FillPrice:.2f}")
                    self.held_contract = None
                    self.entry_fill_price = None

        self.entry_order_id = None
        self.entry_order_pending = False
        self.dates_blocked_from_replacement = set()

    def OptionUniverseFilter(self, universe):
        # Broad filter to ensure target contracts (DTE >= 7, 1% OTM calls) are available
        return universe.CallsOnly().Expiration(7, 60).Strikes(0, 30)

        # Update moving averages only on actual 5-minute bar completion

        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not (self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady):
            return

        curr_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        curr_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        is_crossover = False
        if self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            if self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow and curr_fast > curr_slow:

        self.prev_fast = curr_fast
        self.prev_slow = curr_slow

        bar_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        start_time = datetime.strptime("09:45", "%H:%M").time()
        end_time = datetime.strptime("14:30", "%H:%M").time()

        if not (start_time <= bar_time <= end_time):
            return

        # Check existing holdings or pending entry orders
        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None or self.entry_order_pending or self.Portfolio.Invested:
            return

        # Check replacement block rule (if held into expiration earlier today)
        if self.Time.date() in self.dates_blocked_from_replacement:
            return

        # Evaluate entry immediately after eligible 5-minute bar closes
        self.TryEntry()

        # Inspect option chain delivered in the current Slice
        if not self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Skipped signal: Option chain missing in current slice.")
            return

        chain = self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]

        target_contracts = [
            c for c in exp_contracts

        ]

        if not target_contracts:
            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Skipped signal: No call contracts >= 101% of SPY price ({spy_price:.2f}) for expiry {min_expiry}.")
            return

        # 3. Select lowest strike >= 101% SPY price. Equal-strike tie break by ascending string value of contract Symbol
        selected_contract = min(target_contracts, key=lambda c: (c.Strike, str(c.Symbol)))

        # Explicitly subscribe to minute data for the selected contract security
        self.AddOptionContract(selected_contract.Symbol, Resolution.Minute)

        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)

                self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Entry filled: Purchased 1 contract of {orderEvent.Symbol} at {self.entry_price:.2f}.")

            elif self.held_contract_symbol is not None and orderEvent.Symbol == self.held_contract_symbol:

                    self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Exit filled for {orderEvent.Symbol} at {orderEvent.FillPrice:.2f}.")
                    self.held_contract_symbol = None
                    self.entry_price = None

            elif orderEvent.Symbol == self.spy_symbol:

                    self.Liquidate(self.spy_symbol)

                self.entry_price = None
            return

        curr_date = self.Time.date()

        # 1. Expiration Safety Check: Do not hold into expiration
        if curr_date >= expiry_date:
            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Position held into expiration date {expiry_date}. Liquidating position.")
            self.dates_blocked_from_replacement.add(curr_date)
            self.Liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)
            self.held_contract_symbol = None
            self.entry_price = None
            return

        # 2. Preceding Trading Day Scheduled Time Stop (15:45 NY time)
        if self.Time.hour == 15 and self.Time.minute == 45:
            if self.IsPrecedingTradingDay(curr_date, expiry_date):
                self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] Time stop hit: 15:45 NY time on trading day preceding expiration {expiry_date}. Liquidating {self.held_contract_symbol}.")
                self.Liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)
                self.held_contract_symbol = None
                self.entry_price = None
                return

        # 3. 50% Profit Target Check on each minute Slice
        if self.entry_price is not None and self.entry_price > 0:
            if slice.QuoteBars.ContainsKey(self.held_contract_symbol):
                qb = slice.QuoteBars[self.held_contract_symbol]
                if qb.Bid is not None and qb.Ask is not None:
                    bid = qb.Bid.Close
                    ask = qb.Ask.Close
                    if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                        mid = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                        if mid >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:
                            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] 50% profit target reached (Mid: {mid:.2f}, Entry: {self.entry_price:.2f}). Liquidating {self.held_contract_symbol}.")
                            self.Transactions.CancelOpenOrders(self.held_contract_symbol)
                            self.Liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)
                            self.held_contract_symbol = None
                            self.entry_price = None

    def IsPrecedingTradingDay(self, current_date, expiry_date):

        if current_date >= expiry_date:

        days = self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDays(start_search, expiry_date)
